run_fit_linref_cli: run the fit_references CLI with a config YAML and output path to fit linear element references
fit_linref_function: fit linear element references from a training dataset using a config dictionary and save checkpoints
load_config_yaml: load a YAML configuration file with duplicate key warnings and errors using load_config
save_checkpoint_state_dict: save a model state dict to a checkpoint file using save_checkpoint with a target name
fit_linear_references_targets: compute linear references for specified targets from a dataset using fit_linear_references with batch and worker settings
